title: WLS vs RMP
summary: The Mage holds four and two of them are escapes. Your Shaman holds three — whoever runs out first decides this.

sections.title: Both teams are thin. Yours is thinner
sections.body: Counts, theirs: Rogue 6, Priest 5, Mage 4. Yours: Warrior 8, Lock 4, Shaman 3. Your Shaman is the shortest list in the game and their Rogue's whole plan is reaching him. So this is not a matchup you can play out — the Mage is the target because he is their thinnest and because two of his four only reset the go rather than surviving it.

sections.title: Opener — Fear is the setup, not the go

steps.note: On the Priest. No cooldown, so it costs nothing to open with.
17s root onto the Mage as the Fear lands.
The Mage blinks on 15s. Lead, do not follow.
90s. The cadence term for the whole comp.
60s. Half-cadence; it is in every go.
45s. Up every go — the sustained damage term.
45s. Cross-CC on the Rogue, never on the kill target.
120s. Full immunity — it ends the go rather than blunting it.
30s. Back every go; not a real forcing target.

sections.title: Where this is guessing
sections.body: This plan wants control your build may not have. Howl of Terror and Shadowfury sit on one choice node — you take one. Check what the Warlock actually holds before running the opener, because a Fear that is not on the bar makes the whole sequence a Charge into a full pool.
